headline: Renjishi best kindler
title: Renjishi | Top Kindling Pal and Burn Fighter | Palworld Guide
video_script: Renjishi is one of the best Fire Pals in Palworld one point zero. At your base it has Kindling suitability level eight, plus Handiwork level six. In your party, its partner skill makes your attacks inflict Burn. Its alpha is a level seventy eight boss in the World Tree area, east of the Corroded Hollow, and Water Pals are the way to beat it. Do you want one? Comment below!
description: Renjishi in Palworld 1.0 is a World Tree alpha with Kindling level eight and a partner skill that applies Burn.
